test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The average weight of R, P and K is 40 kg. If the average weight of P and K is 45 kg and average weight of R and K is 35 kg, then what is the weight of K ?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average weight of P, K and R = 40 kg

Total weight of all together = P + K + R = 40 × 3 = 120 ----(i)

Average weight of P and K be 45 and K and R be 35 kg

P + K = 45 × 2 = 90 ----(ii)

K+ R = 35 × 2 = 70 ----(iii)

On solving eq. (i) and (ii)

Weight of R = 30

Then from eq. (iii)

⇒ K + 30 = 70

⇒ K = 40

∴ Weight of K is 40 kg

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
